title: BE SURE YOUR SIN WILL FIND YOU OUT

memory_verse.label: Bible Reference
memory_verse.text: "But if you fail to do this, you will be sinning against the Lord; and you may be sure that your sin will find you out. Build cities for your women and children, and pens for your flocks, but do what you have promised." - Num 32:23-24 (NIV)

devotion.label: Devotion
devotion.text:
Here is one of the most quoted warnings in all of Scripture: "You may be sure that your sin will find you out." Moses is not being harsh; he is being honest. Broken promises and hidden disobedience do not simply disappear. Sin has a way of surfacing, of catching up with us, of revealing itself in time. Nothing is truly hidden from God, and eventually little stays hidden from others either.

We can be tempted to think we have gotten away with something. We cut a corner, break a commitment, hide a wrong, and nothing seems to happen. But sin is not a debt that quietly cancels itself. It remains, and God, who sees all things, is not mocked. A person reaps what they sow (Gal 6:7).

This is a sobering word, but it is meant to lead us to honesty, not despair. The wisest thing we can do with sin is not to hide it but to bring it into the light before God. When we confess, we find not condemnation but cleansing (1 John 1:9).

And here is the deepest comfort of the gospel: for those in Christ, our sin has already been found out — and fully dealt with. It was laid bare and judged at the cross, where Jesus bore it in our place. We do not need to live in fear of exposure, because everything has been brought into the light and covered by His blood. So we walk in honesty, keeping our promises, resting in the forgiveness Christ has won.

reflection.label: Reflection
reflection.text:
1. Is there something hidden you need to bring into the light before God?
2. How does knowing that sin surfaces change how you live in secret?
3. How does the cross free you from the fear of being "found out"?

prayer.label: Prayer
prayer.text: Father, You see all things, and nothing is hidden from You. Give me courage to walk in honesty, to confess my sin, and to rest in the forgiveness Jesus has secured for me. Amen.
